tips.text: Collect the Argon Crystals last, on build day; unspent crystals halve at 00:00 GMT.
Capture on Hepit with Xaku or Limbo; Xaku's Vast Untime with max range breaks every container, then you collect the Argon markers.
Join a public Hepit capture if you lack Xaku or Limbo; others break containers and the Argon markers show for everyone.
Do not hunt Argon specifically; run any Void mission with a Resource Booster and you tend to leave with several.
Run a Kuva Flood for the most Kuva per minute; it also guarantees a Requiem relic.
Buy 10,000 Kuva for 50 Nightwave credits, 25 Vitus Essence or 15 Steel Essence; one purchase covers the whole cost.
Chase the Kuva clouds quickly; if the Siphon absorbs 8 it teleports away and pays at most 350 Kuva.
Stack Ferrite and Alloy Plate and sort Kuva first; a returning player can have everything in one evening.
